pages.title: A silver watch · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a gray afternoon in a quiet street in Boston. Rui walks into a tiny shop with clocks on every wall. The ticking sounds like soft rain. He holds an old silver watch in his hand. It was his grandfather’s watch and it stopped yesterday. A white-haired watchmaker looks up from his table.
“Good afternoon. How can I help you?” says Walt. “My watch stopped yesterday. It was my grandfather’s.” says Rui. “Let me see. It is a beautiful old watch.” says Walt.
